title: TRAUMAHACK
description:
I just need one more payout, and then I'm gone. 

TRAUMAHACK is an atmospheric PSX-inspired survival horror game where you remotely hijack the abandoned bodies of Robot Puppets buried beneath the city. From a cramped apartment that barely keeps the rain out, you descend through forgotten maintenance tunnels, derelict facilities, and places better left sealed. What begins as another job quickly unravels into something far older and more disturbing than abandoned machinery.

Features• A short, atmospheric retro horror game.

• Physical objects and environmental interaction.

• Manage fuses and lighting to survive in environments swallowed by darkness.

• Navigate oppressive industrial spaces inspired by PSX-era horror classics.
description_short: You hack into the abandoned corpses of animatronic "Puppets" from tunnels deep beneath your grungy apartment. Soon, you will have saved enough money to escape this life in the TRAUMAHACK - Atmospheric, PSX, Survival Horror game.
